blocks.prompt: 8. The \(5^{\text{th}}\) and \(9^{\text{th}}\) term of an A.P. are 11 and 17 respectively. Find the sum of 20 terms.
blocks.explanation:
A.P. ki do terms maloom hain, lekin pehli term \(a_1\) aur common difference \(d\) dono nahi. Jama nikalne ke liye yeh dono chahiye.
Diya kya hai? 5th term 11 aur 9th term 17.
Find kya karna hai? Pehli 20 terms ka jama \(S_{20}\).
Plan: dono terms ko \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se likh kar do equations, un se \(a_1\) aur \(d\), phir sum ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_5 = 11\), \(a_9 = 17\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S_{20}\).
Tareeqa: Har di hui term se \(a_1\) aur \(d\) ki ek equation banti hai. Do unknowns ke liye do equations kaafi hain (simultaneous equations). Phir \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) lagayenge.

Do equations likhein
\[a_5 = a_1 + 4d = 11 \quad (1)\]
\[a_9 = a_1 + 8d = 17 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) mein \(n = 5\) rakha to \(a_1 + 4d\), aur \(n = 9\) rakha to \(a_1 + 8d\).

(2) mein se (1) minus karein
\[4d = 6\]
\[d = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: Dono mein \(a_1\) hai; minus karne se woh cancel ho gaya aur sirf \(d\) bacha. Asaan soch: 5th se 9th term tak 4 qadam hain aur term 6 barhi, to har qadam \(\frac{6}{4} = \frac{3}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: \(d\) fraction mein aaya hai, yeh bilkul theek hai; \(d\) ka whole number hona zaroori nahi.

\(a_1\) nikalein
\[a_1 + 4\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right) = 11\]
\[a_1 + 6 = 11\]
\[a_1 = 5\]
Kyun: \(d = \frac{3}{2}\) ko equation (1) mein rakha; \(4 \times \frac{3}{2} = 6\). Phir dono taraf se 6 minus.

Tasdeeq
\[a_9 = 5 + 8 \cdot \dfrac{3}{2} = 17 \;\checkmark\]
\[a_{20} = 5 + 19 \cdot \dfrac{3}{2} = \dfrac{67}{2}\]
\[S_{20} = 10\left(5 + \dfrac{67}{2}\right)\]
\[= 10 \times \dfrac{77}{2} = 385 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Hamari \(a_1\) aur \(d\) se 9th term wapas 17 aayi, yani dono sahi hain. Phir pehli + aakhri wale formula se bhi jama 385 aaya.
blocks.final_answer:
\(S_{20} = 385\) (\(a_1 = 5,\ d = \frac{3}{2}\))
Answer key bhi 385 deti hai.
